title: Circle of Live at Cervantino
location: Main stage, Festival Internacional Cervantino, Guanajuato
excerpt: The second Mexican Circle of Live night, presented with MUTEK MX at the Festival Internacional Cervantino.
description:
The second Mexican Circle of Live night, presented as MUTEK MX x Festival Internacional Cervantino on 12 October 2025, two days after the Nocturne session in Mexico City. Same collaboration, different room, this time the festival's main stage, outdoors in Guanajuato: real-time visuals and light from me, choreography by Alejandra Metztli.
> A set built for one venue has to be rebuilt for the next, and what survives the move is the part that was really the work. In Mexico City the audience circled the musicians. Here it was an outdoor main stage with a crowd in front of it, so the point clouds had to hold a whole square instead of a room.
credits: Real-time visuals and light: Jaco Schilp / Studio Schilp. Choreography: Alejandra Metztli. Circle of Live: Sebastian Mullaert, Pantha du Prince and Leafar Legov. MUTEK MX x Festival Internacional Cervantino, main stage, Guanajuato, 12 October 2025.
